verses.2: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.3: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.4: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.5: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.6: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?
verses.7: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.8: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
